messages:
Mia Chen: ok group — Q3 roadmap sync: we need to lock scope for console telemetry work: dashboards + traces + retention UX. biggest tradeoff is 13mo retention (enterprise ask) vs cost and UI complexity. thoughts?
Samir Patel: priority from sales: 13mo retention is a hard requirement for 2 named accounts, but we can gate it behind an enterprise add-on. maybe ship 90d GA and 13mo as opt-in premium.
Jordan Lee: +1 to opt-in. also need clear launch acceptance: query latency P95 < 300ms for dashboard queries on 90d, and background cold-path retrieval for >90d within 2s index fetch.
Nina Alvarez: can we define concrete metrics? propose: retention-recall >= 99% for kept events, dashboard query success >= 99.5%, cost delta estimate < +25% infra. if any fail, hold launch.
Samir Patel: add customer-driven criteria: UI must show retention window and cost impact in billing preview. Sales needs a screenshot for contract pages.
Mia Chen: ok acceptance list so far: 1) UI retention selector + billing preview 2) query latency targets (Jordan) 3) retention-recall >=99% 4) sampling controls for traces 5) automated migration plan for historical data. Anything else?
Jordan Lee: for traces sampling: default 10% tail + adaptive tracer for spikes. Need an admin toggle per-org and per-service. Also a trace waterfall view and span-level filters for error analysis.
Nina Alvarez: I sketched minimal UX: dropdown for retention, slider for sampling %, and a modal that explains cost vs retention. small mock attached in design board. For rollout, propose phased: beta orgs -> canary -> GA.
Mia Chen: rollout gating: beta must have 3 customers on billing preview, 1 enterprise legal sign-off, 2 weeks stable canary with no severe regressions. define "severe"?
Samir Patel: severe = data loss, >1% production error budget burn tied to the change, or p95 latency regression >30% for critical queries.
Jordan Lee: ops checklist: add tracing sampling metric: trace_ingest_rate, sampled_rate, tail_error_rate. Alert if sampled_rate deviates >10% from expected or if tail_error_rate spikes.
Nina Alvarez: QA tests: automated E2E that sets retention 13mo and runs read-back on archived data, compare rows counts, and assert recall. provide synthetic load for dashboard query latency.
Mia Chen: dev-work estimates? rough: backend retention store & infra changes 4w, dashboard UX + billing preview 2w, trace sampling controls + UI 2w, E2E and canary tooling 2w. total ~10w across teams.
Samir Patel: can we compress by doing 90d GA earlier and parallelize 13mo infra? split into two deliverables in roadmap.
Mia Chen: agree. plan: M1 ship 90d GA + sampling controls + dashboard metrics. M2 gated 13mo retention behind enterprise billing preview and migration tool.
Jordan Lee: quick config snippet for canary rollout I put in #eng-runtime:
```
{
  "feature": "extended_retention",
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "metrics_to_watch": ["dashboard_query_p95", "retention_recall"],
  "rollback_on": {"retention_recall": "<0.99", "dashboard_query_p95_pct_change": ">30"}
}
```
Nina Alvarez: perfect. also add a privacy checklist and KMS review for 13mo.
OpsBot: deploy-bot scheduled canary window for feature extended_retention: start=1945630000, end=1945716400. Watch alerts: retention_recall, dashboard_query_p95.
Mia Chen: next steps: Samir to confirm customer commit for premium opt-in, Jordan scope infra work, Nina stabilize mocks + QA plan. I'll update roadmap card and add OKR alignment: "reduce production inference debug time by 25% via improved traces & dashboards". Ping me with blockers by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
